verdict.rationale: replica-skill is a set of local Claude Code skill files and standard-library Python scripts ("None touch the network"), with no hosted service or API of its own. Issuing scoped API credentials for an agent is therefore a category error for this product. The mention of using "your keys" with Google's API concerns third-party keys the user supplies for the generated clone, not credentials the product issues.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
